player_intent: Preserve the original animation camera-root channel for the current character without changing its movement or skin.
acceptance_rule: Saved285 raw channels retain exact source provenance, independent root samples and mapped source timing. AnimationTree alone writes a non-spatial observer added after skin proportion adaptation and root sanitation. Body keys/bone count/shared source libraries stay unchanged. Explicit terminal-closure removal keeps the observer on the retained body source clock: a one-shot dive must not restore its discarded upright closing frame. Unsupported clips reset coverage instead of exposing stale roots; main stance and real dive-command tests prove actual graph consumption.

nodes.role: Non-spatial independently keyed observation, never a movement or bone writer

visual_check: Main standing/crouch/prone at early/middle/late settled animation and signed camera pitch; compare actual skinned head/chest projection, not placeholder markers.

system_delta.reason: Exact original channels and provenance survive without changing65-bone anatomy or adding a second animation owner. Horizontal root preprocessing is independently audited; the current hybrid consumes these same source channels.

candidate.system: Post-adaptation source observer in existing AnimationTree
